nl: Rename the field Customer of the Go struct store.Order to Client. Keep the JSON tag "customer", format the struct as gofmt does (aligned columns) and update the struct literal in the test.
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'internal/store/store.go'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = '	ID       int     `json:"id"`
	Customer string  `json:"customer"`
	Total    float64 `json:"total"`
'.Replace("`n", "`r`n"); $n = '	ID     int     `json:"id"`
	Client string  `json:"customer"`
	Total  float64 `json:"total"`
'.Replace("`n", "`r`n")
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in internal/store/store.go' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'internal/store/store_test.go'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = 'Customer: "acme"'; $n = 'Client: "acme"'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in internal/store/store_test.go' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
